checklist_tasks.title: Discuss and finalize total wedding budget with both families
checklist_tasks.notes: Agree on overall financial contribution and allocate to primary categories in the Budget tool.

checklist_tasks.title: Shortlist auspicious wedding dates (Mahurat) and consult family Pandit
checklist_tasks.notes: Pick 2-3 alternative dates to check venue availability during high-demand Saaya season.

checklist_tasks.title: Decide on wedding style and destination (Local, Palace, Beach, Resort)
checklist_tasks.notes: Decide whether celebrations will be in hometown or destination venue.

checklist_tasks.title: Prepare initial master guest list count for capacity estimates
checklist_tasks.notes: Crucial for determining banquet hall capacities and hotel room block bookings.

checklist_tasks.title: Decide if hiring a professional Wedding Planner or Family Committee
checklist_tasks.notes: For destination or large-scale (500+ guests) weddings, early planner booking is critical.

checklist_tasks.title: Start venue reconnaissance tours and compare banquet packages
checklist_tasks.notes: Check lawn size, banquet ceiling heights, bridal suite amenities, and catering options.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize and book primary wedding venue & reserve room blocks
checklist_tasks.notes: Sign contract, confirm advance deposit in Bookings module, and freeze dates.

checklist_tasks.title: Book primary Wedding Photographer & Cinematographer
checklist_tasks.notes: Top wedding photographers get booked 6-8 months in advance for peak wedding dates.

checklist_tasks.title: Book Bridal Makeup Artist (HMU) & Hair Stylist for all events
checklist_tasks.notes: Book bridal package covering Mehendi, Sangeet, Wedding, and Reception.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize Wedding Decorator & review theme mood boards
checklist_tasks.notes: Establish floral themes, entrance arches, mandap styling, and stage backdrops.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize catering contract (if venue requires independent caterer)
checklist_tasks.notes: Review per-plate cost, live food counters, and regional cuisine specialties.

checklist_tasks.title: Begin bridal lehenga and groom sherwani designer consultations
checklist_tasks.notes: Custom bridal lehengas and bespoke sherwanis require 3-4 months for crafting and trials.

checklist_tasks.title: Plan and conduct pre-wedding photo/video shoot
checklist_tasks.notes: Finalize location, pre-wedding shoot outfits, and creative teaser themes.

checklist_tasks.title: Book professional Mehendi artist for bride and family members
checklist_tasks.notes: Confirm bridal mehendi design style (Marwari, Arabic, Portrait, Floral).

checklist_tasks.title: Hire wedding invitation designer for digital e-invites and cards
checklist_tasks.notes: Design auspicious wedding monogram, PDF royal invitation cards, and digital videos.

checklist_tasks.title: Confirm availability of Family Pandit / Officiant for ceremonies
checklist_tasks.notes: Verify exact Mahurat timings for Mandap, Saat Phere, and Kanyadaan rituals.

checklist_tasks.title: Book wedding DJ, Sound & Light system, and folk band / Dhol team
checklist_tasks.notes: Confirm equipment, truss lighting, wireless mics, and late-night sound permissions.

checklist_tasks.title: Send digital "Save the Date" announcement to close family & friends
checklist_tasks.notes: Help outstation guests block their travel dates and book flight/train tickets early.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize detailed food & beverage menus for all ceremonies
checklist_tasks.notes: Curate unique menus for Mehendi, Sangeet, Haldi, Wedding Feast, and Reception.

checklist_tasks.title: Dispatch official Wedding Invitations with RSVP links
checklist_tasks.notes: Send via Telegram & Email using portal, and courier boxed invitations to elders.

checklist_tasks.title: Shop for bridal jewelry, gold ornaments, and ceremonial puja items
checklist_tasks.notes: Purchase necklace, maang tikka, nath, bangles, payal, and sacred puja silver.

checklist_tasks.title: Hire choreographer for Sangeet couple & family dance performances
checklist_tasks.notes: Start weekly weekend group dance rehearsals for bride, groom, and cousins.

checklist_tasks.title: Establish detailed wedding event itinerary and share with vendors
checklist_tasks.notes: Define start and end times for Haldi, Mehendi, Baraat entry, Varmala, and Dinner.

checklist_tasks.title: Create curated song playlists for DJ and entrance sequences
checklist_tasks.notes: Curate Baraat entry tracks, Bridal entry song, Varmala background music, and Haldi playlist.

checklist_tasks.title: Order wedding favors, return gifts, and luxury dry fruit boxes
checklist_tasks.notes: Order gift hampers for Milni, Shagun boxes, and welcome favors for hotel rooms.

checklist_tasks.title: Book guest transportation, airport pick-up cabs, and local buses
checklist_tasks.notes: Reserve Innovas/Travellers for shuttling relatives from station/airport to venue.

checklist_tasks.title: Order traditional Safas / Turbans, Badges, and Milni Malas
checklist_tasks.notes: Order matching barati pagris, floral brooches, and welcome garlands.

checklist_tasks.title: Begin pre-bridal and groom skincare/wellness salon regimens
checklist_tasks.notes: Schedule regular hydrating facials, spa sessions, and healthy diet.

checklist_tasks.title: Freeze final RSVP attendance in Guest Manager
checklist_tasks.notes: Check confirmed counts on Guest dashboard and share final plate numbers with caterer.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize hotel room allotment matrix for outstation relatives
checklist_tasks.notes: Assign family suites, tag room numbers, and coordinate check-in batches.

checklist_tasks.title: Conduct final on-site decor walkthrough at venue
checklist_tasks.notes: Verify stage height, Mandap photogenic lighting, selfie booths, and power backup.

checklist_tasks.title: Share must-have shot list and family group schedule with photographer
checklist_tasks.notes: List essential family portraits, candid moments, and drone coverage requirements.

checklist_tasks.title: Complete final outfit trials and tailoring alterations
checklist_tasks.notes: Trial lehenga with bridal footwear, sherwani fit, dupatta drape, and accessories.

checklist_tasks.title: Order wedding cakes and special live dessert / paan counters
checklist_tasks.notes: Finalize tiered wedding cake flavor and live counters (e.g. nitrogen ice cream, paan).

checklist_tasks.title: Professional cleaning and bank locker check for heirloom jewelry
checklist_tasks.notes: Ensure heirloom ornaments are sparkling clean and safely stored.

checklist_tasks.title: Conduct final full-dress Sangeet rehearsal with all performers
checklist_tasks.notes: Confirm music tracks sequence with DJ and test stage floor space.

checklist_tasks.title: Prepare speeches, vows, or thank-you toasts (if applicable)
checklist_tasks.notes: Write warm words of gratitude for parents, mentors, and partners.

checklist_tasks.title: Re-confirm vendor arrival timelines and on-day contact persons
checklist_tasks.notes: Create vendor coordinator contact sheet with phone numbers and setup slots.

checklist_tasks.title: Steam all ceremony outfits and pack ceremony-wise in labeled garment bags
checklist_tasks.notes: Tag each bag: Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, Wedding, Reception with matching accessories.

checklist_tasks.title: Complete bridal trousseau packing and gift presentation wrapping
checklist_tasks.notes: Organize trousseau trays, gift ribbons, and shagun envelopes.

checklist_tasks.title: Prepare cash envelopes (Lifafas) for tips, pandit dakshina, and vendor balances
checklist_tasks.notes: Label envelopes with exact cash amounts for driver, pandit, servers, and musicians.

checklist_tasks.title: Pack emergency bridal & groom survival kits
checklist_tasks.notes: Safety pins, bobby pins, fabric tape, stain wipes, mints, pain relievers, mini perfume.

checklist_tasks.title: Finalize check-in welcome desk and luggage assistance at hotel venue
checklist_tasks.notes: Set up welcome drink station, key card distribution, and event itinerary handouts.

checklist_tasks.title: Ensure breakfast and refreshments are delivered to bridal and groom suites
checklist_tasks.notes: Keep couple well-hydrated and nourished throughout hair and makeup sessions.

checklist_tasks.title: Hand over vendor balance envelopes to designated financial custodian
checklist_tasks.notes: Relieves couple from handling payments during sacred rituals.

checklist_tasks.title: Verify Mandap floral setup, fresh Varmala garlands, and puja samagri
checklist_tasks.notes: Check holy fire havan samagri, gangajal, sweets, and varmalas in cold storage.

checklist_tasks.title: Take deep breaths, smile, and immerse in the joy of the holy matrimony!
checklist_tasks.notes: Enjoy every second of this once-in-a-lifetime celebration with loved ones.

checklist_tasks.title: Settle final venue incidental charges and room checkout balances
checklist_tasks.notes: Inspect room checkouts, verify mini-bar/laundry bills, and close venue contract.

checklist_tasks.title: Send thank-you messages and photo gallery links to attending guests
checklist_tasks.notes: Express heartfelt gratitude to family and friends for blessing the marriage.

checklist_tasks.title: Professional dry cleaning and archival preservation of wedding attires
checklist_tasks.notes: Preserve bridal lehenga and groom sherwani in acid-free preservation boxes.

checklist_tasks.title: Collect and backup RAW photo/cinematography hard drives from photographer
checklist_tasks.notes: Safeguard all high-resolution footage and wedding video timelines.
